scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/web && npm run test -w apps/api && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:compat && npm run build && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:prod
scripts.review: npm run build:e2e -w apps/web && npm run preview:e2e -w apps/web
